notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.8.2
notes.content: Fixed a soft-lock issue in the Twilight Zone.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.8.1
notes.content: Fixed an incorrectly placed terrain collider in the Twilight Zone.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.8
notes.content: Fixed an issue with map markers that could cause the game to crash.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.7.7
notes.content: Added buffer frames for Zip Dash after jumping from an Electro Pad. This should make chaining multiple Up Dashes feel more intuitive.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.7.6
notes.content: This update fixes an issue that caused some Place-able Map Markers to not display correctly.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.7.5
notes.content:
General: 
Made it so that during the startup frames of a horizontal zip dash, you can hold u or down to change the dash into a vertical dash. This should make up dash feel more intuitive.


Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue that made the charge ionizer SFX too loud.
Fixed a rare issue with spike pits that would cause the player to play incorrect animation frames.


Balance:
The Thermal Oscillator now gains damage 20% faster.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Balance tweaks:
[u]Bio Slam[/u]: (Nerf) Increased the cooldown of zip dash after using Bio Slam.
[u]Reverberating Armor[/u]: (Buff) Changed the way this technology calculates damage reduction. All in all, it is now significantly better.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.6 (Balance update)
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed a rare issue that could cause the player to be stunned for a few seconds after falling into a spike pit.
Fixed an issue that caused the game window to shrink if the window lost focus while in full screen mode.

[b]Gameplay Balance Adjustments[/b]
[u]Reverberating Armor[/u]: (Buff) Adjusted this to provide more protection. It was fairly useless before.

[u]Electronic Bifurcator[/u]: (Nerf) This core now has a 0.75x damage multiplier, which also means if used with the Nuclear Discharger, its damage will be -> Base Damage x 0.75 x 0.75. 
After watching some people play the game, I quickly realized that this weapon is FAR too powerful, especially when paired with certain other weapon parts.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.3
notes.content: Fixed an issue that caused text to become distorted on some displays.

notes.title: Xanthiom Zero Patch 1.0.2
notes.content: Fixed an issue that caused pixel distortions on certain displays.
